newsitem.title: CHINA: Deposits at China's largest bank top 2.0 trln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Deposits at China's largest bank top 2.0 trln yuan.

text.p: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the nation's largest bank, became the first bank with savings deposits of more than two trillion yuan at the end of June, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

The amount of deposits held by individuals rose 108.1 billion yuan from the beginning of the year, while the bank's deposits from varoius other sources rose 147.6 billion yuan in the first half, it said.
"Our bank managed to have a rapidly growing business... in spite of growing competition in the banking sector," it quoted a bank official as saying.
The bank also extended 64.3 billion yuan more in loans compared with the start of the year, mainly to efficient enterprises with high credit ratings, Xinhua said.
